newsitem.title: USA: Teamsters chief to make announcement on UPS talks.
newsitem.headline: Teamsters chief to make announcement on UPS talks.

text.p: Teamsters union President Ron Carey will make an announcement on the 12-day-old strike against United Parcel Service at 3 p.m. EDT (1900 GMT) on Friday, a union spokesman said.

"I believe he'll make an announcement and review the status of things," Teamsters spokesman Rand Wilson said after union and company negotiators had met informally for more than 20 hours on Thursday and Friday. Wilson declined to give details of the announcement.

Earlier Friday, the union sent a memo to its branches stressing that the marathon talks have yet to resolve the key disputes in the strike of 185,000 union members at the large package delivery company, Wilson said.
The memo urged Teamsters branch offices to continue to "build strength on the picket lines and in the community."
The strike has cost UPS some $500 million and reduced the company's shipping volume to just 10 percent of the 12 million packages a day prior to the stoppage.
